notes: Open slides/why-slides-as-data.json next to this slide: that file is all there is.

values.title:
Slides are **data**,
templates are code
values.lede: A slide picks a template and fills in its boxes. Fix the template once, and every slide gets the fix.
bullets: A slide is a small JSON file: a template and its values
Templates list their boxes and limits in template.json
`rosling check` catches mistakes before the talk
